morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为外来姓氏整体使用，不作马来语词缀分析；末尾 s 不应直接当作复数标记。这里的 is_root 仅表示本条不作同步派生分析。

senses.zh_definition: 迈尔斯：英语使用环境中可见的姓氏，具体指谁须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname used by people of several distinct family origins.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang digunakan oleh individu daripada beberapa latar keturunan; orang yang dimaksudkan dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正常书写为 Myers；输入的小写形式仅保留作检索词。不能仅凭此姓推断某人的国籍、族群或身份。IPA 给出常见非卷舌英语读法，具体姓名读音以本人为准。status 为指定数据标签，不表示这是 DBP 认证的马来语普通词。以下是自然称谓组合，未声称具有已核实的高频统计。[姓氏资料：Myers](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/myers)

dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Myers akan mempengerusikan mesyuarat tersebut pada pukul sepuluh pagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 迈尔斯先生将于上午十点主持该会议。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Myers will chair the meeting at ten in the morning.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Encik Myers sudah tiba di lobi, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 迈尔斯先生已经到大堂了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Myers is already in the lobby, right?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)

messages.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Myers sudah tiba di lobi?
messages.zh: 迈尔斯先生到大堂了吗？
messages.en: Has Mr Myers arrived in the lobby?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Saya nak turun jemput beliau sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, beliau sudah tiba. Saya hendak turun untuk menjemput beliau sekarang.
messages.en: Yes. I’m going down to meet him now.

etymology.historical_story: Myers has several documented surname histories rather than one universal origin. Some Irish families bear an anglicized Gaelic name; some northern English lines connect with names for marshy places; other families acquired the spelling from continental European surnames. Consequently, an individual’s ancestry cannot be recovered from the spelling Myers alone. [姓氏资料：Myers](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/myers)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Myers 与常见音译“迈尔斯”配对记忆；它是人的姓，不要拆成英语 my 加复数 s。
